players.name: Jayden Clarke
players.bio: A quick first step and an even quicker read of the floor. Jayden sets the tempo for the Rockets, creating space for teammates and pushing the pace in transition.

players.name: Marcus Reed
players.bio: A confident perimeter scorer who thrives in close games. Marcus brings a reliable outside shot, active hands on defence and a calm presence when the pressure rises.

players.name: Oliver Bennett
players.bio: A versatile two-way wing, Oliver can guard multiple positions and finish through contact. His energy on the glass turns defensive stops into fast breaks.

players.name: Theo Morgan
players.bio: A strong interior presence with soft touch around the rim. Theo uses his size to protect the paint, set solid screens and give the Rockets a second chance on offence.

players.name: Leon Williams
players.bio: The anchor of the Rockets defence. Leon controls the boards, challenges every shot in the paint and offers a dependable target on the roll to the basket.

players.name: Samir Patel
players.bio: A high-motor guard who can spark a run from either end of the court. Samir's pressure defence and fearless drives make him a key piece of the second unit.
